exact_claim: On MCAR-generated data at p(d)=0.01, MSNN has FR 4.69% and MRE 0.0391, versus SNN FR 0.03% and MRE 0.806 (Table 1).
falsification_rule: The claim is a conjunction. It is FALSIFIED if the paper-scale protocol reproduces the value labeled MRE only under the released code's normalized-MAE formula while the paper's explicit per-entry relative-error formula yields a materially different value.
non_circularity: Dimensions, seeds, DGP, treatment probabilities, algorithm, rank rule, feasibility thresholds, and both metric formulas were fixed from the paper and pinned author source before results were inspected.
